prompt:
# Yagar Axe: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10063/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Yagar Axe in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the tall center spear point, rounded left crescent, smaller angular swept right blade, long dark shaft, sparse pale bands, and metal end cap. Render one complete upright poleaxe on genuine transparent RGBA without redesign..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Yagar Axe in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the tall center spear point, rounded left crescent, smaller angular swept right blade, long dark shaft, sparse pale bands, and metal end cap. Render one complete upright poleaxe on genuine transparent RGBA without redesign.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10063/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the exact edit target; image 2 design_reference.png is appearance reference; image 3 icon_x8.png is colour reference. Preserve all ten small silhouettes in the atlas, including edge-on views. The full-sheet atlas requirement overrides the descriptive phrase 'one complete upright poleaxe': do not replace the atlas with a single hero object. Dark shaft is wood (yellow in material mask), head, socket, bands and end cap are metal (red). Output transparent 1536x2048 PNG.
CORRECTION: Strictly copy the silhouette layout of paint_mask_guide.png, NOT conventional front/back views. At 1536x2048: row1 col1 and col2 contain ONLY tiny horizontal end-on slivers centered near (256,256) and (768,256), each about 66 pixels wide and 12 high. They MUST NOT contain upright full weapons. Row1 col3 is horizontal spear side profile from x1057 to1503 at y256. Row2 col1 is horizontal side profile x33 to479 at y768. Row2 col2 is upright full poleaxe x735 to802, y545 to990. Row2 col3 empty. Rows3-4 repeat precisely these shapes translated down1024 pixels in red/yellow flat material colours. Tiny slivers at (256,1280),(768,1280), NOT full axes. All silhouettes must be clean, with NO colour bleed, fuzz, coloured aura or additional pixels outside guide outlines. Preserve source image layout exactly. Paint in place.
